notes: REF-BM-02: only title is auto-collected (services/title.ts); no description, favicon, or preview-image scraping exists. REF-BM-03: title is editable pre/post-save, but description is never auto-collected so nothing to edit there. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags are editable via PUT, but there is no distinct markdown 'note' field (only a single description/'Notes' field). REF-BM-07: BookmarkList.tsx renders only title, url, and tags — no description or favicon shown. REF-BM-10: tags input (BookmarkForm.tsx) is a plain comma-separated text field, no autocomplete/datalist. REF-BM-12: search LIKE clause covers title/url/tags only (services/bookmarks.ts list()), not description, and there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' parsing in the search string — tags are filtered only via a separate query param/UI control. REF-BM-15: no boolean/parenthesis operator parsing anywhere; search is a single substring LIKE. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or field exists on Bookmark. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints. REF-BM-22: sort=recent|title is implemented in the API and query schema, but no UI control ever sends a sort param, so it's unreachable by a user. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/archival mechanism (HTML, PDF, or Internet Archive) at all. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive concept — only soft-delete with a time-boxed undo, which is delete-with-grace-period, not a reversible archive/hide feature with its own list. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or endpoints. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export code. REF-BM-32: no settings page/entity for sort persistence, page size, or font size.
